summary: Strive, Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing routine treasury updates rather than a special situation. During September 21-25, 2026 it purchased 1,107 bitcoin at an average ~$85,396 per coin, inclusive of fees, lifting holdings to 27,462 BTC; cash rose $19.2M to $248.8M and STRC preferred stake held at 505,000 shares (~$49.8M). SATA preferred outstanding grew 1,009,020 to 12,193,180 and Class A shares rose 649,072 to 88,453,685. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or transaction terms were disclosed; watch continued ATM-style issuance and bitcoin purchase cadence as dilution signals.
